summary: Frontend-only testing of FoeGuard hero tri-image layout, SVG logo, mobile Resources dropdown, new /faq and /delivery pages, and menu shopping regression. 100% of requested checks passed. Tri-image layout is mathematically correct (left=476x476px square, right images 235x238 & 235x235 stacked, sum 473px ~ left 476px; only 3px separator borders from charcoal frame; 8px 8px shadow + 3px charcoal border + 20px radius). SVG FoeGuard wordmark renders (no broken images). FAQ page renders 4 categories, 15 accordion items with exactly 1 expanded by default, toggling works (open->close, closed->open). FAQ CTA navigates to /contact. Delivery page renders all 4 step cards, all 6 facts rows, store+thaw storage tips, shop CTA -> /menu, meal-plan CTA -> /meal-plan. Mobile menu shows SVG logo and Resources dropdown reveals FAQ/Delivery Information/Blog. Regression: /menu/comfort-dinner adds 6lb Comfort Chicken @ $26.99, slide cart opens with correct subtotal, no console errors.

issues: Uses legacy Navbar with original red FoeGuard circular logo image instead of the new ModernNavbar SVG wordmark. This creates a visual inconsistency: users see the new modern cream navbar on /, /faq, /delivery but a different red navbar with circular logo when clicking into a product line. Outside this task's scope but worth aligning for brand consistency.

passed_tests: Desktop hero tri-image: 3 images present, all roughly square (1.00, 0.99, 1.00 ratios)
Tri-image left height (476px) ~= sum of right two (473px)
Tri-image has 8px 8px 0px rgba(0,0,0,0.2) shadow + 3px charcoal border + no gap (only 3px internal separators)
FoeGuard SVG logo renders in navbar with shield + paw + 'Foe' (charcoal) + 'Guard' (red); no broken images
Mobile menu hamburger opens slide menu showing same SVG logo
Mobile Resources dropdown reveals FAQ, Delivery Information, and Blog links
/faq loads with FAQ red pill, 4 category sections (Getting Started, Ordering & Subscriptions, Delivery & Storage, Health & Nutrition)
/faq has 15 accordion items with exactly 1 expanded by default
/faq clicking a closed accordion item expands it; clicking an open one collapses it
/delivery shows 4 numbered step cards: Made fresh, Dry-ice (packed), Door-to-door, Freshness promise
/delivery Facts table shows all 6 rows: Coverage area, Free shipping, Flat shipping, Delivery days, Order cut-off, Transit time
/delivery 'How to store + thaw your meals' storage tips section present
Regression: /menu/comfort-dinner add 6lb Comfort Chicken to cart -> slide cart opens with Subtotal $26.99
Zero console errors during shopping flow
action_items: Optional: align ProductLinePage and TreatsPage to use the new ModernNavbar (with SVG wordmark) for brand consistency. Currently they still render the legacy red Navbar with the circular image logo.

Optional accessibility: AccordionItem button in FaqPage.js (line 97) has no aria-expanded attribute. Adding aria-expanded={isOpen} would improve accessibility and assistive-tech compatibility. Function still works because state is rendered via conditional ChevronUp/ChevronDown.
critical_code_review_comments: LandingPage.js is 1204 lines - exceeds 700-line guideline. Consider extracting FoeGuardLogo, ModernNavbar, SlideCart, TrustMarquee, and the various sections into separate components/files.
FAQ accordion uses conditional rendering ({isOpen && <div>}) instead of aria-expanded — minor a11y gap (see action_items).
ProductLinePage/TreatsPage still imports legacy Navbar — brand inconsistency once user navigates from landing into product line.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All requested checks pass. Note that /menu (MenuPage) is a category list page, not a product page — clicking 'Comfort Dinner' navigates to /menu/comfort-dinner which is the ProductLinePage (product detail with size pills + Add button). The product detail uses a different legacy Navbar (red bar with circular FoeGuard image logo) — this is a known visual inconsistency but is functional. FoeGuardLogo is an inline SVG in LandingPage.js (~line 59), exported via ModernNavbar. The hero tri-image uses a 2fr 1fr CSS grid with aspectRatio 3/2 — left image fills the full container square (height equals container), right column has two 1fr rows totaling the same height.
